Moving high-profile murder suspects into a robust federal jurisdiction bypasses compromised local judicial systems.

The Unavoidable Truth: Cross-border legal cooperation is essential when domestic institutions are too compromised to judge.

The Unavoidable Lie: Extradition alone solves the deep political instability plaguing Haiti.
